style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=11;fontColor=#1F2937;" value="<font color='#0078D4'><b>1</b></font>&nbsp; Analysts → Web App: HTTPS, loads the React app (static files only)<br><font color='#0078D4'><b>2</b></font>&nbsp; Analysts → Function App /api/*: HTTPS with an Entra access token<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;(MSAL sign-in, scope Board.Access); CORS allows only the web origin<br><font color='#0078D4'><b>3</b></font>&nbsp; Agents → MCP /runtime/webhooks/mcp with an app-only Entra token,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;validated and role-checked on every tool call<br><b>4</b>&nbsp; Function App → PostgreSQL: TLS, Entra token as the password<br><font color='#0F766E'><b>5</b></font>&nbsp; Read: incident poller, advanced hunting, entity lookups<br><font color='#B91C1C'><b>6</b></font>&nbsp; Write: containment only after policy + human approval<br><b>7</b>&nbsp; Reference agent → Foundry Messages API with an Entra token<br>Sign-in goes to Microsoft Entra ID (login.microsoftonline.com).<br>The Function App reaches storage and Application Insights with its<br>managed identity; no shared keys or connection secrets.<br><br>Agents hold <b>no</b> Microsoft security permissions. No hop uses a stored secret." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="275" width="545" x="1215" y="660" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c52" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=9;fontColor=#4B5563;" value="Azure icons © Microsoft, used unmodified under the Azure architecture icon terms. .NET 10 isolated · scales to zero · max 40 instances
HTTP /api/*: REST for the web app (CORS: web origin only)

Action broker: policy → human approval → execute

Timers: incident poller (1 min) · stuck-action recovery
migrations applied at start-up · identity: blueboard-id-api

div.div:
1 Analysts → Web App: HTTPS, loads the React app (static files only)
2 Analysts → Function App /api/*: HTTPS with an Entra access token
(MSAL sign-in, scope Board.Access); CORS allows only the web origin
3 Agents → MCP /runtime/webhooks/mcp with an app-only Entra token,
validated and role-checked on every tool call
4 Function App → PostgreSQL: TLS, Entra token as the password
5 Read: incident poller, advanced hunting, entity lookups
6 Write: containment only after policy + human approval
7 Reference agent → Foundry Messages API with an Entra token
Sign-in goes to Microsoft Entra ID (login.microsoftonline.com).
The Function App reaches storage and Application Insights with its
managed identity; no shared keys or connection secrets.
Agents hold no Microsoft security permissions. No hop uses a stored secret.
